description: Full details of one result from find: a person (skills, services with prices, areas, hours, verified badges, and public phone/WhatsApp when they chose to show them), a business (what they do, area, services or products with prices, opening hours, public phone/WhatsApp, and `bookingsEnabled`) or a job (role, type, place, skills, description). Pass the `kind` and `username` that find returned.

kind.description: The kind from the find result.

username.description: The username (or, for a mini app, its slug) from the find result.

name: get
title: Get one result in full
